title: Bedroom or study major opening offset 1.5 m from a parallel adjoining opening
text: Notwithstanding C3.9.2, a major opening to a bedroom or study may be offset a minimum of 1.5m from a parallel major opening on an adjoining property, measured from the edge of one major opening to another (refer Figure 3.9g).
notes: from: ch3 C3.10.3 (renumbered C3.9.3). Bedroom and study openings only; measured edge to edge between parallel openings. May not address overlooking of other floor levels (p45 note). Applies to sources with a floor level more than 0.5 m above NGL; the cone radius includes the width of any adjoining ROW, communal street or battleaxe leg (p45 note). C3.9.4 applies C3.9.1-C3.9.3 between apartments on the same lot.
